approved: Frames B1 and B2 (one point CB, pan 35 deg; linen shower curtain on a ceiling L-track instead of the fluted screen, single oak vanity on the south wall, window X 3.45-4.25, wall-hung WC under it) with their slots approved 2026-10-08 (verbatim: "סבב 2 נראה מעולה", on assets/blockout/house/framing/round2/all-round2.jpg, tiles B1 and B2), with the density decision (verbatim: "כתוב מינימום מוצרים..לדעתי כמה שיותר שהמעצב יחליט שזה לא גורע. ו3 וואריציות מתאימות לנורדי לכל מוצר"). 1.0 includes the clay fixes: curtain gather point (B2 corner line), floor-group order (toilet brush), and the bath lighting / white-balance intent. Rules: docs/design-bible/nordic.md 1.6 (U6 in 'room exceptions' + rooms: bath); geometry: docs/house-plan.md/json 1.1 (6.8). 1.0.1 (2026-10-13, QA round-2 consistency fixes, no design change; assets/qa/round2-binding-docs-qa.md): category per slot (Q8), the cut east mirror sconce in B1 documented (Q9), bath-towels z 34 -> 36, towel-ring 48 -> 50, hand-towel 49 -> 52 off the shadow z values, bin 44 -> 42 and toilet-brush 44 -> 48 (the floor group overlaps by design), and tie-break rule (Q10), electrician install on every lamp and no visible cable on the ceiling light (Q14), bridge note for T-CBath (Q18); density rule per user decision D1B (2026-10-11). 1.0.2 (2026-10-17, user decision R5C1, docs/studio-rules.md ז): shower-curtain drop 200-265 (was 255-265), with extension hooks under 255; no other change.
notes: Both frames share camera point CB, so ONE z-order serves both, and ONE mirror reflection pass (F8) covers both. frames = master frames where the product is visible by design. category = Bible controlled vocabulary (textile, lighting, ceramics-tableware, storage-function, art-decor-toys); fixed-product furniture is storage-function. placement uses the product-card enum; placement_detail names the surface. z = layer order bottom to top; shadow at z-1 unless has_shadow_layer is false. Tie-break: product layers that share a z never overlap by design (if they do, the one nearer the camera goes on top); shadow layers are multiply and order-independent; no product shares its z with a shadow layer. plan_m in house coordinates, Z from the floor. envelope_cm = max envelope per variant; 3 variants within +-15%. Nothing may stand in the mirror reflection zone (north wall Y 9.95-12.39 up to the ceiling, and the ceiling above it). Every bath lamp is IP44+, hardwired, no visible cable, electrician install, no fabric or paper shade. hotspot and zoom_frame after the shell render.

lighting_intent.why: With the 0.80 x 1.15 fluted window the clay is near dark on daylight alone (mean L 36 in B1, 25 in B2; round 1: 78/75) and very orange with the lamps on, because no white balance was applied.
lighting_intent.key: daylight from the fluted window stays the key and the brightest surface in B1; the wall by the window reaches L 86-90 by raising the soft area light outside the window, not the global exposure (Bible: <= +0.2 stop)
lighting_intent.practicals: B1 wall light and the mirror sconce pair lit in BOTH frames (the pan is continuous); shower downlight (shell) lit low so the limestone and the niche read; ceiling light off in the master frames
lighting_intent.white_balance_note: exception for B1/B2 only (4600 K elsewhere): lamps stay 2700 K and look warm, walls read warm white (H 32-40, S 15-28), limestone keeps its oat tone (H 35-42)
lighting_intent.qa: measure the white wall above the WC (B1) and either side of the mirror (B2), and the limestone; wall S > 30 or H < 30 (orange) fails

density.rule: Bible 1.7.1 S11: lean frames, minimum 11 is a floor; as many as the designer judges do not detract (B1 is already full on its left half: no additions). Counted (rule D1, 2026-10-10, with user decision D1B, 2026-10-11) = a slot whose product is >= 50% visible and covers >= 0.5% of the frame; a set counts once; fixed-product furniture counts under the same rule (D1B: here the vanity, in B2; in B1 only its top corner enters); not counted: neighbouring-room products, fillers, shell, fixed furniture that is not sold. A frame still short gets sold products from docs/proposals/density-after-d1.md (D1B). The counts below were estimated under the rejected 1.6 wording; the D1 counts in that proposal were measured without fixed-product: B2 to re-measure with fixed-product counted (next clay).
